Data Centers and Consent: AI Meets Its Political Limit

From energy demand in the United States to the rejection reflected in polls, the boom in data centers is shifting the debate on artificial intelligence from the laboratory to the public sphere. As the industry calls for fewer regulations, the perceived social and environmental costs of the supporting infrastructure are increasing.
